sources.termsEvidence: The Council open-data page says transparency data is reusable under the Open Government Licence without asking permission and requires source attribution. The data catalog lists News and press, and identifies RSS as a format for some Council data. OGL v3 explicitly permits use in an application and commercial/non-commercial reuse. Exclude material marked third-party, personal data, logos, and other exclusions.
sources.retentionStatus: Pilot: metadata only for rolling 30 days; retain attribution/provenance with derived snapshots for the same period; no media, descriptions or article bodies. Correct/remove excluded or withdrawn records on review.

sources.attribution: Hinckley & Bosworth Borough Council. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
admissionConditions: Exclude marked third-party and personal-data items; no logos/media/description ingestion.
Keep geography unknown unless an explicit subject-location rule has evidence.
Poll no faster than 300 seconds initially, obey Cache-Control/Retry-After and exponential backoff; no published source-specific rate asserted.
Expose original link, attribution, OGL link, update time and coverage. No implied Council endorsement.
Future-dated or missing publication timestamps stay flagged and must not create artificial momentum.
